_comment: Governance-pinned provider data policy (REQ-11.5/11.8). Before a bundle is sent, every ContextPiece.path is checked against the routed adapter's allowPaths globs; a pathless piece may travel only when its kind is in pathlessKinds. A violation escalates data_policy_violation and sends nothing. Globs: '*' matches within a path segment, '**' across '/'. Per-adapter entries override 'default'. This file is hashed into the governance policy snapshot (REQ-9.1).
